en.activity.hint: What this idea has been through: who did what, and when. The last {count} moves are kept.
en.activity.label: Activity ({count})
en.backup.exportDesc: Writes a timestamped copy of the whole board — every idea, its history and its tags — into your backups folder, then offers it to you as a download. The last {retention} copies are kept; older ones are removed. It is also the way out when a second Host refuses to start on this same DSH home, because that one already owns the board.
en.backup.groupTransfer: Move this board to another machine
en.backup.import: Import a board from a file
en.backup.importDesc: Loads a file exported here (or dropped into your backups folder). It REPLACES the current board, and the board it replaces is kept as a snapshot you can go back to. A file that cannot be read is refused with its reason, and nothing is changed.
en.backup.intro: The board is a file on this machine. These actions keep timestamped copies of it, put one back, and carry it to another machine.
en.backup.restoreBusy: A run is in flight — a restore is refused until it finishes.
en.backup.restoreConfirm: Replace the current board with this snapshot?
en.backup.restoreConfirmDesc: The board you have now is kept as its own snapshot first, so you can go back to it. A run still in progress refuses the restore.
en.backup.restoreDone: Restored {source} — {count} ideas. The board it replaced was kept as {displaced}.
en.backup.restoreHint: Replace the current board with this snapshot
en.backup.restoreUnknownFields: Heads up: this file carried fields this version does not know, so they were not restored: {fields}. If it came from a newer version of the plugin, update the plugin and restore again.
en.backup.retention: The last {retention} copies are kept. Files you drop in the folder yourself are never removed.
en.backup.unavailable: Snapshots and restore are not available on the running instance — the board itself is unaffected. If you just updated the plugin, restart the web instance: the browser half reloads with the page, the routes are registered at start-up.
en.board.columnResize: Resize this column — min {min}px, max {max}px; double-click to reset
en.board.dragHint: Drag cards between columns, and reorder them inside the Open column (use the ⠿ grip on the title row)
en.board.jump: Go to an idea by its number
en.board.jumpHidden: Idea {ref} is declined, and the Declined column is hidden — there is no card to bring into view.
en.board.jumpUnknown: No idea on this board matches {ref}. It may have been deleted, or the number belongs to another board.
en.board.openColumnNotice: This column holds {count} open ideas. Scroll to reach the rest — drag & drop and multi-select still cover the whole column.
en.board.title: Ideas
en.board.workspaceHint: Scope the board to one workspace
en.bulk.archive.hint: Already archived ideas stay as they are and declined ones are left untouched: archiving them would erase the decline.
en.bulk.archive.title: Archive {count} idea(s)
en.bulk.bar.archiveHint: Move the selected ideas to the Archived column
en.bulk.bar.tagHint: Add labels to the selected ideas, keeping the ones they already carry
en.bulk.bar.workspaceHint: Move the selected ideas to another workspace
en.bulk.note.leftOpen: left in Open — archive it by hand
en.bulk.note.rearchived: archived again after the failed update
en.bulk.reason.declined: declined — restore it before changing it
en.bulk.reason.drifted: changed since the action — undo skipped it
en.bulk.report.title: Bulk action report
en.bulk.roundTrip: An archived idea bound to a task card is restored, updated and archived again, so its card follows the change.
en.bulk.scope.label: Scope: {scope}
en.bulk.tag.hint: Existing labels are kept; an idea can carry up to 8 of them.
en.bulk.tag.invalid: Label name too long (32 characters max): {tags}
en.bulk.tag.label: Labels to add (comma separated)
en.bulk.tag.title: Tag {count} idea(s)
en.bulk.undoDone: {count} idea(s) restored into the open backlog.
en.bulk.undoHint: A bulk archive is reversible: the button below restores exactly the ideas that were just archived.
en.bulk.undoNote: This batch can be undone: the “Undo” button, or Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z).
en.bulk.workspace.label: Target workspace
en.bulk.workspace.title: Move {count} idea(s)
en.card.deliveredHint: Delivered idea — click to edit or restore
en.card.deliveryNoteEmpty: This run left no delivery note: open the session to see what happened.
en.card.deliveryNoteHint: What the last finished run said last. "Open session" is still the way to watch the whole run.
en.card.dragTakesOver: Drag to move this card to another column, or to reorder this one: reordering by hand makes the column show YOUR order, which takes over from the default sort until you pick another order in the settings.
en.card.findSimilarHint: Ask the analyst whether this open idea duplicates something already in this workspace backlog: the board lists its own candidates, the analyst reads their real content and reports. Nothing is merged without you.
en.card.followUpHint: Not approved: create a follow-up idea and archive this one
en.card.followUpOfHint: Idea created from a failed acceptance review
en.card.launchHint: Start this idea execution on its TaskBoard card: a new session receives the idea as its instruction. On success the card turns done and the idea moves to the review gate
en.card.openSessionHint: Open, in DSH, the conversation this idea was worked on
en.card.reanalyzeHint: Run a fresh AI analysis on this open idea: a new session will rewrite the analysis and the priority opinion; the previous analysis is preserved on the card
en.card.taskFailedHint: The linked TaskBoard task failed (last observed status): the idea stays in the backlog - retry the task or adjust the idea
en.card.taskRunningHint: An execution of this idea is in flight. The idea stays in the backlog until the run settles, then moves to the review gate automatically.
en.delivered.hint: Ideas that left the open backlog (archived) — green stamp for delivered, neutral for manually archived
en.edit.title: Edit idea {number}
en.entry.label: Ideas
en.followUp.justification: Justification of the request (included in the new idea body)
en.followUp.title: Follow-up needed
en.health.deliveredWindow: current calendar month ({month}), on the host clock
en.health.hint: Backlog overview for {scope} — the figures are computed by the host, never recounted by the board
en.health.inconsistent: {count} stamp(s) precede their own creation — they are never averaged in.
en.health.medianThinHint: a median is only printed from {min} real deliveries
en.health.openHint: and how that open work splits across workspaces
en.health.stale: Figures computed at revision {revision} — the board has moved on since.
en.health.staleError: Figures are from revision {revision}, and the refresh failed: {error}
en.health.tagsEmpty: No label on the open backlog
en.health.triageHint: work to do on your ideas, never a quality score
en.health.unavailable: This deployment does not serve the health view; the rest of the board works as usual.
en.health.withoutStamp: {count} idea(s) left the backlog with no delivery stamp — they are not counted in the median.
en.launch.blockedBelowHint: This idea waits for {blockers}, which sits lower in its workspace ranking. The board flags it, it does not stop you: whether the run still makes sense is your call.
en.launch.blockedHint: This idea is still waiting for {blockers}. You can launch anyway: the board flags it, it does not stop you.
en.launch.defaultHint: Ideas in this workspace launch on this model, unless you pick another one for a single run.
en.launch.defaultNeedsModel: Pick a model above to make it the default for {workspace}.
en.launch.defaultUnchanged: Already the default for {workspace}. Change the model or the reasoning effort to save a new one.
en.launch.effortCardBacked: This idea runs through its TaskBoard card, which pins the model and nothing else — a reasoning effort could not travel with it, so no level is offered here.
en.launch.hint: A new session will implement this idea in workspace {workspace}. The chosen model is pinned on the card before the run; without a pick the session keeps its default model. On success the idea moves to the review gate automatically.
en.launch.permissionHint: The TaskBoard refuses to run this card until a human confirms its permission (it is above the session default). Bring the card into view here, or open the TaskBoard and find it under this title to confirm its permission.
en.launch.sessionHint: No task card is linked to this idea: the launch opens a brand-new chat session in its workspace, with the default DSH permission. It keeps running if you close this tab.
en.launch.title: Launch execution
en.new.aiCaptureHint: A new session will analyze the idea, create it in this workspace's backlog (or merge a duplicate) and report the retained ranking to you.
en.new.modelHint: Preselected from your session's model; pick a provider then a model to force another one, or leave «Inherit from session» for the analyzing session to keep its own default model
en.new.rankInvalid: Rank must be a positive integer (1 = first of the open backlog)
en.new.rankValueEffortHint: Priority is relative to the idea's own workspace open backlog: rank = position (triage inserts and re-ranks the existing rows), value/effort = 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high
en.new.rationalePlaceholder: Why this rank? (value, effort, dependencies, project state)
en.new.sessionWorkspaceHint: Current session workspace — change if needed
en.new.submitAi: Start AI analysis and create the idea
en.new.title: Title
en.priorities.hint: Suggested ranking of the open backlog, relative inside each workspace group (the workspace-less ideas rank together) — use the arrows or drag to adjust
en.reanalyze.hint: A fresh analyst session will rewrite the title, analysis, tags and priority opinion of this open idea (workspace {workspace}); the previous analysis is preserved on the card.
en.reanalyze.title: Re-analyze with AI
en.relations.addBlocked: Add an idea this one blocks…
en.relations.blockedByExplained: A "waiting for this idea" link is declared on the other card: open it to remove it.
en.relations.blockedByRankConflict: {target} cannot land before this one, and the backlog still schedules it below this card. A flagged contradiction, never an enforced one: reorder if you mean it.
en.relations.hint: Links you state yourself, never ones the board infers: an idea worth reading next to this one, or an idea that cannot land before this one.
en.relations.relatesToHint: Related to {target} — read that one too
en.relations.targetGone: The idea {id} this link names is no longer on the board.
en.relations.title: Relations
en.settings.cardDensityDesc: Normal: full rendering. Compact: the Overview cards AND the Priorities/Delivered rows hide their tags, description, date and workspace, with tighter spacing too — title and value/effort badges stay.
en.settings.columnMaxWidthDesc: Largest a kanban column can be dragged to, in pixels: 240 to 1382, default 922. A column never grows past this bound.
en.settings.columnMinWidthDesc: Smallest a kanban column can be dragged to, in pixels: 120 to 480, default 200. Drag a column's right edge to resize it; double-click that edge to reset its width.
en.settings.confirmLifecycleDesc: Ask for an in-place confirmation (Yes/No) before Deliver or Decline, like Delete does. Off by default: those actions apply in one click.
en.settings.conflict: The settings changed since this page loaded: refresh it, then try again.
en.settings.defaultTabDesc: The board section opened when the panel starts: Overview, Priorities, Delivered or Health. Switching tabs during a session stays free and is kept as the fallback when settings are unavailable.
en.settings.directRunPermissionDesc: Level granted to the fresh session when you launch an idea with no TaskBoard card. Defaults to workspace-write: the run brief asks for implementation, so a read-only session would only produce a plan. No effect on card-backed ideas, which follow the TaskBoard setting.
en.settings.hideDeclinedDesc: Do not show the board Declined column (saves space). Declined ideas leave the kanban view: they stay in the ledger and the markdown export. Off by default.
en.settings.intro: Display preferences for the Ideas panel, stored in this DSH profile's settings and applied immediately (no restart).
en.settings.languageDesc: The panel's own language, independent of the DSH shell setting: by default it follows the shell (a Chinese shell shows a Chinese panel), or pin English, Français or 中文.
en.settings.openOrderingDesc: The default order of the Open column. It is only a default: as soon as you reorder that column by hand, it shows your order. Pick another order here to go back to a date view.
en.settings.rememberScopeDesc: When on, the panel reopens on the last selected workspace instead of All workspaces. Off by default.
en.settings.renderMarkdown: Render descriptions as Markdown by default
en.settings.renderMarkdownDesc: Show card bodies as rendered markdown when the panel opens; the MD/Text header toggle still switches freely per session. On by default.
en.settings.runningFirst: Show running ideas at the top
en.settings.runningFirstDesc: Floats the ideas whose run is in flight above the order picked above, without changing that order. While this is on, the displayed order differs from the stored rank; reordering by hand still works, and the column then shows your order.
en.settings.staleAfterDaysDesc: Days without an update before an open idea wears a quiet "Stale" badge: 0 to 3650, default 30. 0 turns the badge off entirely. Computed while rendering, nothing is stored on the idea.
en.settings.tagRowsDesc: Total rows of tags shown before the zone scrolls: 1 to 5, default 3. The first row shares its space with the search and the Clear filter button; the remaining tags stay reachable by scrolling.
en.settings.title: Ideas board options
en.settings.unavailable: Settings are not available in this deployment: the default value applies.
en.similar.empty: Nothing similar in this workspace open backlog.
en.similar.hint: The board compared this idea with {scanned} open idea(s) of workspace {workspace} and kept the closest ones. An analyst session will read their real content and report, for each, whether it is a duplicate — it merges nothing.
en.similar.signalLegend: A cheap signal (title and tag overlap), not a verdict: the analyst reads each candidate before judging it.
en.similar.title: Find similar ideas
en.tab.label: Ideas board sections
en.undo.failed: Undone on {applied} idea(s); {failed} could not be and are unchanged.
en.undo.failedAll: Nothing was undone: {failed} idea(s) could not be.
en.undo.label.restore: the return of {count} idea(s) to Open
en.undo.label.workspace: the move of {count} idea(s) to another workspace
en.undo.refused: Undone on {applied} idea(s); {refused} changed since and were left untouched.
en.undo.refusedAll: Nothing was undone: {refused} idea(s) changed since the action.
en.undo.scope: Undo covers this board’s own edits and this batch. It does not cover delete, merge, follow-up, decline or delivery: those gestures have no inverse verb, and the interface does not pretend otherwise.
